::: {#def-recursive-definition}
#### Recursive definition

Let $n_0$ be an integer (@def-integers).
A **recursive definition** [@wikipedia_recursive_definition]
of a function (@def-function) $f$ on the integers $n \ge n_0$ has two parts:

1. *Base case:*
   the value of $f$ is given directly at $n_0$,
   and possibly at a few more of the smallest inputs.
2. *Recursive rule:*
   $f(n)$ at every other input $n$ is given
   in terms of the values of $f$ at inputs that are smaller than $n$ and at least $n_0$.

:::
